# Sniffspot

> > Sniffspot is a peer-to-peer marketplace for renting private dog parks, fields, beaches, and specialized facilities for off-leash exercise and training.

Sniffspot connects dog owners with available spaces ranging from fenced yards to agility parks, water parks, and hiking trails across major US cities. The platform serves dog training, socialization, and exercise needs through hourly rentals of both public and private facilities.

## Key Topics

- Private dog parks
- Dog park rentals
- Off-leash exercise
- Hourly rentals
- Fenced dog parks
- Dog training
- Dog reactivity
- Dog socialization
- Pet exercise facilities
- Agility parks
- Dog water parks
- Dog beaches

- Hiking trails

## Specialized Dog Facilities

- [Fenced Dog Parks](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/fenced-parks): Fully fenced dog parks for safe off-leash exercise and training
- [Dog Agility Parks](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/dog-agility-parks): Dog agility parks with training equipment for rent
- [Water Parks & Swimming Pools](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/water-parks): Dog water parks and swimming pools available for hourly rental
- [Dog Beaches](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/dog-beaches): Off-leash dog beaches available for hourly rental
- [Hiking Trails](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/hiking-trails): Off-leash dog hiking trails available for hourly rental
- [Indoor Dog Parks](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/indoor-dog-parks): Indoor dog parks for year-round exercise and training
- [Dog Fields](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/dog-parks-fields): Open dog fields for rent with fencing and exercise facilities
- [Small Dog Parks](https://www.sniffspot.com/listings/small-dog-friendly): Small dog-friendly parks for safe socialization and exercise

## Dog Care & Training Resources

- [Dog Care & Resources Hub](https://www.sniffspot.com/blog): Hub for dog care guides, training, and owner resources
- [Dog Training Guides](https://www.sniffspot.com/blog/dog-training): Dog training guides covering behavior modification and techniques
- [Managing Reactive Dogs](https://www.sniffspot.com/blog/dog-reactivity): Guides on managing dog reactivity and anxiety in dogs
